subject.title: fix(parallel): resolve env search key refs

question: Is the dispatch-level mocked proof sufficient for this pre-network credential-resolution fix, or must the contributor demonstrate a successful request to the real Parallel service?
rationale: Repository policy requires real after-fix behavior proof for external PRs, but the changed invariant is credential selection before network dispatch and the existing tests directly observe the outbound header and fail-closed path; accepting less than live service proof therefore requires explicit owner intent.

options.title: Require live Parallel proof
options.body: Keep the proof gate until a redacted real Parallel search shows an env-backed SecretRef succeeds and a missing configured ref fails without ambient fallback.

options.title: Approve a proof override
options.body: Accept the dispatch-level header and zero-request tests as sufficient for this bounded pre-network change and record an explicit maintainer override.

recommendation.title: Require live Parallel proof
recommendation.body: Keep the proof gate until a redacted real Parallel search shows an env-backed SecretRef succeeds and a missing configured ref fails without ambient fallback.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent SecretRef contract work makes this the strongest available routing candidate for deciding whether the observed dispatch proof covers the intended credential invariant.
